title: Collections Standard: Unpaid Periods and the Tow Notice Fee on the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
**Standard.** The tow notice fee level on a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement is multiplied by 1.5 where the rent charges posted on the agreement in the last 3 months outnumber its payments in that time by three or more, and by 1.25 where they outnumber them by exactly two; otherwise this standard makes no adjustment.

A window of the last 3 months covers entries dated less than 3 whole calendar months before the handling date, whole months being counted to the same day of the later month. Rent charges are placed in the window by their posting date and payments by the date received.

| Input: rent charges in window, payments in window | Judgement: charges exceed payments by | Output |
|---|---|---|
| 3 charges, 0 payments | 3 | fee level multiplied by 1.5 |
| 4 charges, 1 payment | 3 | fee level multiplied by 1.5 |
| 3 charges, 1 payment | 2 | fee level multiplied by 1.25 |
| 3 charges, 2 payments | 1 | no adjustment |
| 2 charges, 3 payments | none | no adjustment |

The multiplication acts on the fee level, and the product is not rounded at this point; the fee is rounded to the cent at the end. Hypothetical figure: a fee level of $55.00 multiplied by 1.25 is $68.75; multiplied by 1.5 it is $82.50.
